note: Scripture authority is the Open Word Bible (OWB), Amharic, Balanced edition (CC0), bundled as library/data/bible/owb-am-b.json.gz and read offline (owb-am). Every Scripture quotation was re-quoted to it verbatim (founder decision, 2026-11-18: Amharic quotes OWB everywhere), replacing the 1962/2003 UBS wording and the translator-rendered Old Testament verses the first edition carried.

One wording book-wide: the daily line 'Be ye holy, for I am holy' is 1 Pet 1:16 «እኔ ቅዱስ ስለ ሆንኩ እናንተ ቅዱሳን ሁኑ» (the cited Leviticus verse where Murray names Leviticus); 'I am holy: I make holy' is Lev 21:8 «የምቀድሳችሁ እኔ እግዚአብሔር ቅዱስ ነኝ», its parts «እኔ እግዚአብሔር ቅዱስ ነኝ», «ቅዱሳን ሁኑ», «እቀድሳችኋለሁ» (Lev 20:8); 'Holiness to the Lord' is ለእግዚአብሔር የተቀደሰ; John 17:17 and 17:19 read OWB's ለይተህ ቀድሳቸው / ራሴን ለይቼ እቀድሳለሁ wherever echoed; 'Thy will be done' is «ፈቃድህ ይሁን»; Jehovah is እግዚአብሔር. Murray's blend 'Be holy, as I am holy' is no OWB verse and stays his words.

A `mined` row is a verbatim OWB span in that block: the whole verse, the shortest contiguous span, or exact OWB pieces joined with '…'. Key words follow OWB inside quotations; Murray's prose keeps the translator's word except where he explains the quoted word, where it follows OWB or carries a one-time bridge (Ex 15:11 'glorious' → የተዋብህ፥ ማለትም … የከበረ; Ex 19:5 'voice' → ቃል፥ ማለትም ድምፅ; Isa 57:15 'contrite' → መቀጥቀጥ; John 10:36 'sanctified' → ለይቶ የቀደሰ; 2 Tim 2:21 'vessel unto honour'). Murray's slips 2 Thess 2:12 → 2:13 and Lev 22:21 → 22:31 are corrected in the citations.

`self_rendered` rows (each with a `why`) are allusions and paraphrases in Murray's own sentences, prayers re-personed, quotations from other writers (Saphir, Godet, Stockmayer, Bengel), joins of exact OWB pieces from two books (which the checker cannot read as one reference), and quotations kept in the translator's wording because OWB lacks the word Murray argues from (listed for the founder in the PR).
